User Scripts.name: Create New AD User
User Scripts.description: Create a new Active Directory user with first/last name, username, password, and OU path
User Scripts.template:
# Create New Active Directory User
#Requires -Modules ActiveDirectory
# Generated: $(Get-Date)

$Username = "{{username}}"
$FirstName = "{{firstname}}"
$LastName = "{{lastname}}"
$Password = ConvertTo-SecureString "{{password}}" -AsPlainText -Force
$OUPath = "{{ou_path}}"

Write-Host "=== CREATE ACTIVE DIRECTORY USER ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

try {
    New-ADUser -Name "$FirstName $LastName" `
        -GivenName $FirstName `
        -Surname $LastName `
        -SamAccountName $Username `
        -UserPrincipalName "$Username@company.com" `
        -Path $OUPath `
        -AccountPassword $Password `
        -Enabled $true `
        -ChangePasswordAtLogon $true
    
    Write-Host "✅ User $Username created successfully!" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "Full Name: $FirstName $LastName" -ForegroundColor Gray
    Write-Host "OU Path: $OUPath" -ForegroundColor Gray
    Write-Host "User must change password at next logon" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}
catch {
    Write-Host "[ERROR] Failed to create user: $_" -ForegroundColor Red
}

System.name: Domain Controller Basic Hardening
System.description: Lockout, password policy, SMBv1, firewall, auditing, RDP security, disable Guest and risky services
System.template:
# Domain Controller Basic Hardening
# Generated: $(Get-Date)
# NOTE: Requires Domain Admin privileges

$LockoutThreshold = if ('{{LockoutThreshold}}' -match '^\d+$') { [int]'{{LockoutThreshold}}' } else { 5 }
$LockoutDuration = if ('{{LockoutDuration}}' -match '^\d+$') { [int]'{{LockoutDuration}}' } else { 30 }
$MinPasswordLength = if ('{{MinPasswordLength}}' -match '^\d+$') { [int]'{{MinPasswordLength}}' } else { 14 }
$MaxPasswordAge = if ('{{MaxPasswordAge}}' -match '^\d+$') { [int]'{{MaxPasswordAge}}' } else { 90 }
$PasswordHistory = if ('{{PasswordHistory}}' -match '^\d+$') { [int]'{{PasswordHistory}}' } else { 24 }

Write-Host "=== DC BASIC HARDENING ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Config: Lockout=$LockoutThreshold attempts, Duration=$LockoutDuration min, MinPwd=$MinPasswordLength chars" -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host ""

Write-Host "[1/8] Account Lockout Policy..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
net accounts /lockoutthreshold:$LockoutThreshold /lockoutduration:$LockoutDuration /lockoutwindow:$LockoutDuration
Write-Host "  ✅ Done" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[2/8] Password Policy..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
net accounts /minpwlen:$MinPasswordLength /maxpwage:$MaxPasswordAge /minpwage:1 /uniquepw:$PasswordHistory
Write-Host "  ✅ Done" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[3/8] Disable SMBv1..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-SmbServerConfiguration -EnableSMB1Protocol $false -Force
Write-Host "  ✅ SMBv1 disabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[4/8] Enable Firewall..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain,Public,Private -Enabled True
Write-Host "  ✅ Firewall enabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[5/8] Audit Policies..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
auditpol /set /category:"Account Logon" /success:enable /failure:enable
auditpol /set /category:"Account Management" /success:enable /failure:enable
auditpol /set /category:"Logon/Logoff" /success:enable /failure:enable
Write-Host "  ✅ Auditing enabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[6/8] Disable Guest..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
net user guest /active:no
Write-Host "  ✅ Guest disabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[7/8] RDP Security..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server\WinStations\RDP-Tcp' -Name 'UserAuthentication' -Value 1
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server\WinStations\RDP-Tcp' -Name 'MinEncryptionLevel' -Value 3
Write-Host "  ✅ RDP hardened" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[8/8] Disable Services..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
@('RemoteRegistry', 'SSDPSRV', 'upnphost') | ForEach-Object { Stop-Service $_ -Force -EA SilentlyContinue; Set-Service $_ -StartupType Disabled -EA SilentlyContinue }
Write-Host "  ✅ Services disabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== COMPLETE ===" -ForegroundColor Green

System.name: Domain Controller Advanced Hardening
System.description: LDAP signing, channel binding, Kerberos, NTLM restriction, AdminSDHolder, PrintNightmare, log size, Credential Guard
System.template:
# DC Advanced Hardening
# Generated: $(Get-Date)
# NOTE: Requires Domain Admin privileges

$AdminSDProtectFrequency = if ('{{AdminSDProtectFrequency}}' -match '^\d+$') { [int]'{{AdminSDProtectFrequency}}' } else { 600 }
$SecurityLogSizeMB = if ('{{SecurityLogSizeMB}}' -match '^\d+$') { [int]'{{SecurityLogSizeMB}}' } else { 4000 }
$SecurityLogSizeBytes = $SecurityLogSizeMB * 1024 * 1024

Write-Host "=== DC ADVANCED HARDENING ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

Write-Host "[1/10] LDAP Signing..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\NTDS\Parameters' -Name 'LDAPServerIntegrity' -Value 2 -Type DWord
Write-Host "  ✅ LDAP signing enforced" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[2/10] LDAP Channel Binding..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\NTDS\Parameters' -Name 'LdapEnforceChannelBinding' -Value 2 -Type DWord
Write-Host "  ✅ Channel binding enforced" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[3/10] Kerberos Encryption (AES only)..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\Kerberos\Parameters' -Name 'SupportedEncryptionTypes' -Value 0x18 -Type DWord -Force
Write-Host "  ✅ Weak encryption disabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[4/10] Restrict NTLM..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa' -Name 'RestrictSendingNTLMTraffic' -Value 2 -Type DWord
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa' -Name 'LmCompatibilityLevel' -Value 5 -Type DWord
Write-Host "  ✅ NTLM restricted" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "  ⚠ Ensure Kerberos support" -ForegroundColor Yellow

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[5/10] AdminSDHolder..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\NTDS\Parameters' -Name 'AdminSDProtectFrequency' -Value $AdminSDProtectFrequency -Type DWord
Write-Host "  ✅ Check interval: $($AdminSDProtectFrequency / 60) min" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[6/10] Disable Print Spooler..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Stop-Service Spooler -Force -EA SilentlyContinue
Set-Service Spooler -StartupType Disabled
Write-Host "  ✅ PrintNightmare protection" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[7/10] Security Log Size..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
wevtutil sl Security /ms:$SecurityLogSizeBytes
Write-Host "  ✅ Log size: $SecurityLogSizeMB MB" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[8/10] Credential Guard..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa' -Name 'LsaCfgFlags' -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
Write-Host "  ✅ Enabled (reboot required)" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[9/10] Restrict Anonymous..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa' -Name 'RestrictAnonymous' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa' -Name 'RestrictAnonymousSAM' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Write-Host "  ✅ Anonymous restricted" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[10/10] Protected Users Group..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
try {
    Get-ADGroup -Identity 'Protected Users' | Out-Null
    Write-Host "  ✅ Available - add privileged accounts manually" -ForegroundColor Green
} catch {
    Write-Host "  ⚠ Not available (2012 R2+ required)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== COMPLETE - REBOOT REQUIRED ===" -ForegroundColor Green

System.name: AD Endpoint Hardening
System.description: Harden domain-joined endpoints: LLMNR, NetBIOS, WPAD, PowerShell logging, Defender, SMBv1, AutoRun, UAC, firewall
System.template:
# AD Endpoint Hardening
# Generated: $(Get-Date)
# NOTE: Run on domain-joined endpoints (preferably via GPO script)

$DisableLLMNR = ('{{DisableLLMNR}}' -eq 'true')
$DisableNetBIOS = ('{{DisableNetBIOS}}' -eq 'true')
$DisableWSH = ('{{DisableWSH}}' -eq 'true')
$EnableControlledFolder = ('{{EnableControlledFolder}}' -eq 'true')

Write-Host "=== AD ENDPOINT HARDENING ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

if ($DisableLLMNR) {
    Write-Host "[1] Disable LLMNR..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\DNSClient' -Force | Out-Null
    Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\DNSClient' -Name 'EnableMulticast' -Value 0 -Type DWord
    Write-Host "  ✅ LLMNR disabled" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "[1] LLMNR left as-is (not disabled)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

if ($DisableNetBIOS) {
    Write-Host "[2] Disable NetBIOS..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Get-WmiObject Win32_NetworkAdapterConfiguration | Where-Object {$_.IPEnabled} | ForEach-Object { $_.SetTcpipNetbios(2) | Out-Null }
    Write-Host "  ✅ NetBIOS disabled" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "[2] NetBIOS left as-is (not disabled)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

Write-Host "[3] Disable WPAD..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings\Wpad' -Name 'WpadOverride' -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force
Write-Host "  ✅ WPAD disabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[4] Credential Guard..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa' -Name 'LsaCfgFlags' -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
Write-Host "  ✅ Enabled" -ForegroundColor Green

if ($DisableWSH) {
    Write-Host "[5] Disable WSH..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows Script Host\Settings' -Force | Out-Null
    Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows Script Host\Settings' -Name 'Enabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord
    Write-Host "  ✅ WSH disabled" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "[5] WSH left enabled" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

Write-Host "[6] PowerShell Policy..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope LocalMachine -Force
Write-Host "  ✅ RemoteSigned" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[7] PowerShell Logging..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\ScriptBlockLogging' -Force | Out-Null
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\ScriptBlockLogging' -Name 'EnableScriptBlockLogging' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Write-Host "  ✅ Logging enabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[8] Disable SMBv1..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol -NoRestart
Write-Host "  ✅ SMBv1 disabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[9] Windows Defender..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $false -DisableBehaviorMonitoring $false -DisableIOAVProtection $false
if ($EnableControlledFolder) { Set-MpPreference -EnableControlledFolderAccess Enabled }
Write-Host "  ✅ Defender enabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[10] Disable AutoRun..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' -Name 'NoDriveTypeAutoRun' -Value 255 -Type DWord
Write-Host "  ✅ AutoRun disabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[11] UAC..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' -Name 'EnableLUA' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Write-Host "  ✅ UAC enabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[12] Firewall..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain,Public,Private -Enabled True
Write-Host "  ✅ Firewall enabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== COMPLETE - REBOOT REQUIRED ===" -ForegroundColor Green

Domain Migration.name: 02. Unjoin Old Domain
Domain Migration.description: Stop user processes, unjoin from old domain. Runs in PowerShell (as Admin) or as SYSTEM.
Domain Migration.template:
# ==========================================================
# UNJOIN OLD DOMAIN
# Local admin + stop user processes + unjoin
# Works in plain PowerShell (run as Admin) or as SYSTEM
# ==========================================================

param(
    [string]$OldDomainUser = "{{OldDomainUser}}",
    [string]$OldDomainPass = "{{OldDomainPass}}"
)

Write-Host "=== Pre-Unjoin Domain Started ==="

# GUARDRAILS - MUST RUN AS ADMIN OR SYSTEM
$identity = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
$principal = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal($identity)
$isAdmin = $principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)
$isSystem = ($identity.User.Value -eq 'S-1-5-18')

if (-not $isAdmin -and -not $isSystem) {
    Write-Error "Run as Administrator or SYSTEM. Current user: $($identity.Name)"
    exit 1
}

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($OldDomainUser)) {
    Write-Error "Old domain admin username is required (e.g. OLDDOMAIN\\admin)"
    exit 1
}
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($OldDomainPass)) {
    Write-Error "Old domain admin password is required"
    exit 1
}

# STOP USER-DEPENDENT PROCESSES
Write-Host "Stopping user-dependent processes..."
$Processes = @(
    "OneDrive.exe",
    "ms-teams.exe",
    "Teams.exe",
    "msedge.exe",
    "chrome.exe"
)
foreach ($p in $Processes) {
    taskkill /f /im $p 2>$null
}
Write-Host "Processes stopped."

# BUILD CREDENTIAL AND UNJOIN
Write-Host "Unjoining from old domain..."
$SecurePass = ConvertTo-SecureString $OldDomainPass -AsPlainText -Force
$OldDomainCred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential($OldDomainUser, $SecurePass)

Remove-Computer -UnjoinDomainCredential $OldDomainCred -Force -Restart

Domain Migration.name: 03. Join New Domain
Domain Migration.description: Join computer to new domain. Runs in PowerShell (as Admin) or as SYSTEM.
Domain Migration.template:
# ==========================================================
# JOIN NEW DOMAIN
# Works in plain PowerShell (run as Admin) or as SYSTEM
# All values from script parameters - no Ninja/env vars required
# ==========================================================

param(
    [string]$DomainFQDN = "{{DomainFQDN}}",
    [string]$DomainJoinUser = "{{DomainJoinUser}}",
    [string]$DomainJoinPassword = "{{DomainJoinPassword}}",
    [string]$DnsServer = "{{DnsServer}}"
)

Write-Host "=== Domain Join Process Started ==="

# GUARDRAILS - MUST RUN AS ADMIN (or SYSTEM)
$identity = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
$principal = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal($identity)
$isAdmin = $principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)
$isSystem = ($identity.User.Value -eq 'S-1-5-18')

if (-not $isAdmin -and -not $isSystem) {
    Write-Error "Run as Administrator or SYSTEM. Current user: $($identity.Name)"
    exit 1
}

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DomainFQDN)) {
    Write-Error "Domain FQDN is required (e.g. contoso.com)"
    exit 1
}
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DomainJoinUser)) {
    Write-Error "Domain join user is required (e.g. DOMAIN\joiner or joiner@domain.com)"
    exit 1
}
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DomainJoinPassword)) {
    Write-Error "Domain join password is required"
    exit 1
}
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DnsServer)) {
    Write-Error "DNS server (DC IP/hostname) is required"
    exit 1
}

# SET DNS TO NEW DC
Write-Host "Setting DNS to $DnsServer"
$adapter = Get-NetAdapter | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'Up' } | Select-Object -First 1

if (-not $adapter) {
    Write-Error "No active network adapter found"
    exit 1
}

Set-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceIndex $adapter.ifIndex -ServerAddresses $DnsServer
ipconfig /flushdns | Out-Null

# DNS CHECK
try {
    Resolve-DnsName $DomainFQDN -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
}
catch {
    Write-Error "DNS resolution failed for $DomainFQDN. Check DNS server and network."
    exit 1
}

Write-Host "Joining domain $DomainFQDN using $DomainJoinUser"

$SecurePass = ConvertTo-SecureString $DomainJoinPassword -AsPlainText -Force
$Cred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential($DomainJoinUser, $SecurePass)

Add-Computer -DomainName $DomainFQDN -Credential $Cred -Force -Restart

System.name: Local PC Hardening
System.description: Harden a single Windows PC: Defender, firewall, RDP, SMBv1, UAC, password/lockout policy and more
System.template:
# Local PC Hardening
# Generated: $(Get-Date)

$MinPasswordLength = if ('{{MinPasswordLength}}' -match '^\d+$') { [int]'{{MinPasswordLength}}' } else { 12 }
$LockoutThreshold = if ('{{LockoutThreshold}}' -match '^\d+$') { [int]'{{LockoutThreshold}}' } else { 5 }
$LockoutDuration = if ('{{LockoutDuration}}' -match '^\d+$') { [int]'{{LockoutDuration}}' } else { 30 }
$DisableRDP = ('{{DisableRDP}}' -eq 'true')
$EnableControlledFolder = ('{{EnableControlledFolder}}' -eq 'true')

Write-Host "=== LOCAL PC HARDENING ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "" 

Write-Host "[1] Windows Defender..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $false -DisableBehaviorMonitoring $false -PUAProtection Enabled
if ($EnableControlledFolder) { Set-MpPreference -EnableControlledFolderAccess Enabled }
Write-Host "  ✅ Defender enabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[2] Firewall..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain,Public,Private -Enabled True
Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Public,Private -DefaultInboundAction Block
Write-Host "  ✅ Firewall enabled" -ForegroundColor Green

if ($DisableRDP) {
    Write-Host "[3] Disable RDP..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server' -Name 'fDenyTSConnections' -Value 1
    Disable-NetFirewallRule -DisplayGroup 'Remote Desktop'
    Write-Host "  ✅ RDP disabled" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "[3] RDP left enabled" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

Write-Host "[4] Disable Remote Assistance..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Remote Assistance' -Name 'fAllowToGetHelp' -Value 0
Write-Host "  ✅ Done" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[5] Disable SMBv1..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol -NoRestart
Write-Host "  ✅ SMBv1 disabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[6] Disable AutoRun..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' -Name 'NoDriveTypeAutoRun' -Value 255 -Type DWord
Write-Host "  ✅ AutoRun disabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[7] UAC Maximum..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' -Name 'EnableLUA' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' -Name 'ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin' -Value 2 -Type DWord
Write-Host "  ✅ UAC configured" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[8] Disable Guest..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
net user guest /active:no
Write-Host "  ✅ Guest disabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[9] Password Policy..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
net accounts /minpwlen:$MinPasswordLength /maxpwage:90 /minpwage:1 /uniquepw:5
Write-Host "  ✅ Min length: $MinPasswordLength" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[10] Account Lockout..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
net accounts /lockoutthreshold:$LockoutThreshold /lockoutduration:$LockoutDuration /lockoutwindow:$LockoutDuration
Write-Host "  ✅ Lockout: $LockoutThreshold attempts" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[11] Disable WSH..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows Script Host\Settings' -Name 'Enabled' -Value 0
Write-Host "  ✅ WSH disabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[12] Disable Services..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
@('RemoteRegistry', 'SSDPSRV', 'upnphost', 'XblAuthManager', 'XblGameSave') | ForEach-Object { Stop-Service $_ -Force -EA SilentlyContinue; Set-Service $_ -StartupType Disabled -EA SilentlyContinue }
Write-Host "  ✅ Services disabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[13] Windows Update..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU' -Force -EA SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU' -Name 'NoAutoUpdate' -Value 0 -Force -EA SilentlyContinue
Write-Host "  ✅ Auto-update enabled" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "[14] Audit Policies..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
auditpol /set /category:"Account Logon" /success:enable /failure:enable
auditpol /set /category:"Logon/Logoff" /success:enable /failure:enable
Write-Host "  ✅ Auditing enabled" -ForegroundColor Green

network_tools.description: Ping a host to check connectivity
network_tools.template:
# Ping Connectivity Test
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== PING: {{hostname}} ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""
try {
  $r = Test-Connection -ComputerName '{{hostname}}' -Count 4 -ErrorAction Stop
  $avg = ($r | Measure-Object -Property ResponseTime -Average).Average
  Write-Host "  Status: " -NoNewline; Write-Host "Reachable" -ForegroundColor Green
  Write-Host "  Average latency: $([math]::Round($avg,0)) ms" -ForegroundColor White
  Write-Host "  Packets: 4 sent, 4 received" -ForegroundColor Gray
} catch {
  Write-Host "  Status: " -NoNewline; Write-Host "Unreachable" -ForegroundColor Red
  Write-Host "  Error: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Gray
}
Write-Host ""

network_tools.name: IP Configuration
network_tools.template:
# IP Configuration
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== IP CONFIGURATION ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""
Get-NetIPConfiguration | ForEach-Object {
  $a = $_.IPv4Address; $g = $_.IPv4DefaultGateway
  Write-Host "  Interface: $($_.InterfaceAlias)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
  Write-Host "  IPv4: $($a.IPAddress) / $($a.PrefixLength)" -ForegroundColor White
  if ($g) { Write-Host "  Gateway: $($g.NextHop)" -ForegroundColor Gray }
  Write-Host "  DNS: $(($_.DNSServer | Where-Object AddressFamily -eq 2).ServerAddresses -join ', ')" -ForegroundColor Gray
  Write-Host ""
}
Write-Host "  Status: Display complete" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ""

system_maintenance.name: Clear Print Queue & Restart Spooler
system_maintenance.description: Stop runaway printing: clear print queue, restart Spooler service. Requires Administrator.
system_maintenance.template:
# Clear Print Queue & Restart Spooler
# Generated: $(Get-Date)
# NOTE: This script requires Administrator privileges

Write-Host "=== STOP RUNAWAY PRINTING ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

$IsAdmin = ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal] [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)
if (-not $IsAdmin) {
    Write-Host "[!] WARNING: This script is not running as Administrator" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "    This operation requires admin privileges to work properly" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host ""
}

try {
    Write-Host "Stopping Print Spooler service..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Stop-Service Spooler -Force -ErrorAction Stop
    Write-Host "  [OK] Print Spooler stopped" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ""
    
    Write-Host "Clearing print queue files..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    $SpoolPath = "$env:SystemRoot\System32\spool\PRINTERS\*"
    $FilesRemoved = (Get-ChildItem -Path "$env:SystemRoot\System32\spool\PRINTERS" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count
    Remove-Item $SpoolPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Write-Host "  [OK] Removed $FilesRemoved file(s) from spool folder" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ""
    
    Write-Host "Starting Print Spooler service..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Start-Service Spooler -ErrorAction Stop
    Write-Host "  [OK] Print Spooler started" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ""
    
    Write-Host "Removing any remaining print jobs..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    $JobsCleared = 0
    Get-Printer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object {
        $PrinterName = $_.Name
        $Jobs = Get-PrintJob -PrinterName $PrinterName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if ($Jobs) {
            $Jobs | Remove-PrintJob -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            $JobsCleared += ($Jobs | Measure-Object).Count
            Write-Host "  Cleared jobs from: $PrinterName" -ForegroundColor Gray
        }
    }
    Write-Host "  [OK] Cleared $JobsCleared print job(s)" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ""
    
    Write-Host "✅ SUCCESS: Print queues cleared, Spooler restarted" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "All print jobs have been stopped and removed." -ForegroundColor Cyan
} catch {
    Write-Host "[ERROR] Failed to clear print queue: $_" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "Make sure you are running PowerShell as Administrator" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

troubleshooting.name: Reset Network Stack
troubleshooting.description: Reset TCP/IP, Winsock, flush DNS, release and renew IP. Requires Administrator. Restart required after.
troubleshooting.template:
# Reset Network Stack
# Generated: $(Get-Date)
# NOTE: This script requires Administrator privileges and will require restart

Write-Host "=== RESET NETWORK STACK ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

Write-Host "Resetting TCP/IP stack..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
netsh int ip reset

Write-Host "Resetting Winsock catalog..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
netsh winsock reset

Write-Host "Flushing DNS cache..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
ipconfig /flushdns

Write-Host "Releasing IP address..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
ipconfig /release

Write-Host "Renewing IP address..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
ipconfig /renew

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Network stack reset complete" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "A system restart is required for changes to take effect" -ForegroundColor Red

microsoft_office.name: Increase Outlook PST Size Limit
microsoft_office.description: Raise Outlook PST file size limits (100 GB max, 95 GB warning) via registry. Restart Outlook after.
microsoft_office.template:
# Increase Outlook PST Size Limit
# Generated: $(Get-Date)

$k1 = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Outlook\PST'
$k2 = 'HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Outlook\PST'
$m = 100 * 1024
$w = 95 * 1024
foreach ($k in @($k1, $k2)) {
  if (!(Test-Path $k)) { New-Item $k -Force | Out-Null }
  New-ItemProperty $k MaxLargeFileSize -Type DWord -Value $m -Force | Out-Null
  New-ItemProperty $k WarnLargeFileSize -Type DWord -Value $w -Force | Out-Null
}
Write-Host 'Done. Restart Outlook.' -ForegroundColor Green
